gbm_population_evidence.quote: Anaplastic Oligodendroglioma; Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant, Grade 3; Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant, Grade 4; Diffuse Astrocytoma; Glioblastoma, IDH-Wildtype; Malignant Glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I/II trial tests the safety, side effects best dose and effect of retifanlimab with or without difluoromethylornithine (DFMO)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiographic disease progression, with or without tissue confirmation
Retifanlimab With or Without Difluoromethylornithine for the Treatment of Progressive High Grade Gliomas

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Change in T cell/myeloid cell ratio (phase IIa)
Both dose limiting toxicity and pharmacodynamic activity will be used to identify the best dose to bring forward for the phase IIa portion.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive retifanlimab IV, over 30 minutes on day 1 of cycle 1 and DFMO PO Q8H on days 1-14 of cycle 1 in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: may help the body's immune system attack the cancer
arms: Group A (retifanlimab and DFMO then surgery)
Group B2 (retifanlimab and DFMO then surgery)

role_evidence.quote: DFMO is in a class of medications called ornithine decarboxylase (ODC) inhibitors.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: blocking the action of a substance that signals tumor cells to multiply
arms: Group A (retifanlimab and DFMO then surgery)
Group B2 (retifanlimab and DFMO then surgery)

coder_notes: Both drugs are investigational together; B1 gets retifanlimab alone in the pre-surgery window (DFMO added after surgery per arm text), so it works as the retifanlimab-alone comparator. Registry intervention lists per arm are inconsistent (Group A lists no eflornithine; B1 lists eflornithine but no retifanlimab); arms assigned from arm descriptions. IDH-wildtype GBM is one allowed diagnosis among several including IDH-mutant, so not an entry requirement biomarker. Eligibility includes non-GBM high-grade gliomas.
